from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One paper from the collection, with its title and references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title as published")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER papers in this collection that this paper cites in its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
